address: 1010 Expo Blvd (formerly 1050 Expo Blvd), Vancouver, BC
owner: City of Vancouver (site transferred by Concord Pacific under the False Creek North social housing agreement, 2023)
land_tenure_plan: City-owned; BC Housing develops and the BC Indigenous Housing Society operates under a lease (terms to confirm)
notes: A triangular surface parking lot between Expo Blvd, Pacific Blvd and the Cambie Bridge, inside the False Creek North ODP area (CD-1; by-law number to confirm). Site area is derived from the development application's floor area and FSR (23,215 m² at 5.94) and the frontage and depth are an equivalent rectangle, so the plan figure is a stand-in for the real triangle. No tree survey is in the public record; the lot is paved. Transit-oriented area tier is left null until the City's TOA map is checked (Stadium-Chinatown and Yaletown-Roundhouse stations are both within about 800 m). The rule stack has no CD-1 outright schedule, so the memo's 'outright: yes' means no coded outright limit was tested, not that a 29-storey tower is permitted outright: the ODP and CD-1 amendments of July 2023 were the rezoning.
